scope: macOS arm64, pinned Codex CLI 0.163.0, single foreground local profile, controlled Git code fixture and fixed Node test verification profile
testScopeNotes: Component TAP includes real SQLite/Git/Node subprocesses and synthetic stdio/test events; native model/application evidence is listed separately.
Native approval/interrupt probes use internal trusted fixture mode; the desktop approval button regression uses synthetic stdio.
The real desktop code/continuation task uses production frozen-contract execution and independent real sandbox verification, not synthetic model metadata.
limitations: Only this platform and fixed Node profile are accepted; other platform or verification profiles require their own baseline.
Native user-input elicitation remains component-only; file-change approval accepts no grants, Steer and Legacy reconciliation remain disabled.
Unclosed executors, missing/ambiguous history, unconfirmed server replies and unsafe native policies remain blocked; Unknown never auto-resends.
Background ownership, broad concurrency/crash recovery, scheduler, memory, devices and release distribution remain future phases.
